tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List every destination with a published price series, with how many days each rail was actually measured and the calendar span those measurements fall in. Historical observations only.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Price series for one destination: measured span, stats, a downsampled sample of points and any regime breaks. Historical observations only, never a live quote or a recommendation.

tools.name: current_vs_history
tools.description: Stats for one destination (min, median, and what share of the TRACKED DAYS were dearer than the last measurement) without the sample points. Percentages are over observed days, not over the calendar span. Descriptive only: it does not say whether to buy.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Rank every published rail by how its LAST measurement compares with its own tracked history, so a caller can ask 'where is it unusually cheap right now?' in one call instead of one call per destination. Percentages are over observed days, not the calendar span. `latest_cheaper_than_pct_of_days` is t

tools.name: compare_destinations
tools.description: Put 2-8 named destinations side by side on the same snapshot, each with the stats current_vs_history reports (last measurement, median, min, share of TRACKED DAYS that were dearer). Numbers are for the WHOLE party, not per person, and percentages are over observed days rather than the calendar span.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "find_opportunities" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_opportunities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
